new_articles.summary: Hyundai Motor 관련 기사다. 기사 제목은 'Hyundai bets on Talegaon as export hub, capacity expansion fuels growth ambitions'이다. The additional capacity comes at a crucial time for HMIL, which has faced rising competition and production constraints in recent years. ece Hyundai Motor India’s (HMIL) Talegaon expansion is central to its ₹45,000 crore investment roadmap, which includes 26 product launches by FY2030 | Photo Credit: AMIT DAVE Hyundai Motor India’s (HMIL) Talegaon expansion is central to its ₹45,000 crore investment roadmap, which includes 26 product launches by FY2030 and a target of exporting about 30 per cent of vehicles produced in India Hyundai plans to export the model to around 35 markets, compared with 28 for the outgoing generation Motilal Oswal expects Hyundai’s volumes to grow about 9 per cent annually between FY2026 and FY2028, driven by new launches and a strong export order book, while exports could expand at around 12 per cent annually Hyundai plans to expand Talegaon’s capacity to 250,000 units by 2028 and 320,000 units by 2030, cementing India’s role as a key manufacturing and export hub within the group. 이 기사는 해당 기업과 연결된 해외 보도를 바탕으로 정리했다.
